title: NYC Airbnb Room Type Predictor
description: Multi-class classification pipeline predicting NYC Airbnb accommodation room types using ColumnTransformer preprocessing, SMOTE resampling, and tuned Random Forest, served via FastAPI.
businessProblem: Predict NYC Airbnb room type (Entire home/apt, Private room, Shared room) from location, price, and listing activity while handling severe class imbalance (~2.4% shared rooms).
workflow: Data ingestion, missing value imputation, and 99th-percentile outlier capping
Exploratory spatial, price, and class distribution analysis
ColumnTransformer numerical scaling & categorical one-hot encoding
SMOTE oversampling on training data to balance minority classes
Algorithm benchmarking (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest)
Hyperparameter optimization via RandomizedSearchCV targeting Macro F1
Model evaluation on 16,136 holdout test listings
FastAPI inference microservice and interactive web dashboard
results: Achieved 85.40% overall test accuracy and 0.7393 Macro F1 on 16,136 holdout listings, significantly improving minority shared-room F1 to 0.50 after SMOTE resampling.
lessonsLearned: SMOTE balancing is vital for multi-class problems with rare classes (~2.4%). Encapsulating imputation, scaling, and encoding within a ColumnTransformer guarantees data leakage prevention.
